tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the rental software platforms covered in one section, with their ids, plans and the date their prices were last verified.

tools.name: price_at_size
tools.description: Monthly subscription cost of every plan (or of the platforms you name) at a given number of units (long-term) or listings (short-term), cheapest first. Plans whose price is only a starting rate, or that add an unpublished fee or a share of each booking, are marked final_price=false and listed after

tools.name: platform_details
tools.description: Plans, price models, published fees (payments, screening, bookings), company facts and official sources for one platform.
